title: HTTP anti-rug polling requests the whole outstanding range unchunked, so a gap larger than the provider log-range limit fails every poll from then on

evidence.note: getLogs from lastBlock + 1 to current, no chunking

evidence.ref: sed -n 1279,1300p of the base snapshot (22-27 merge)
evidence.note: Claude verification: lines re-read. A failed poll leaves lastBlock unchanged, so the range only grows. Not reproduced against a provider.

sibling_sites_checked: Backfill uses a chunked helper (getLogsForBackfill) and TH-ANTIRUG-06 holds that cap. The HTTP poller does not use it.
severity_rationale: S2: only chains running without a WebSocket URL, after an outage larger than the provider range limit. Same grade as the related HTTP poller defect AUD-ANTIRUG-007. Protection then stays off until restart.
recommendation: Use the chunked helper in the poller; decide the outage handling in card ANTIRUG-02. Phase 29 (S2-S4). Nothing is fixed in Phase 22 (NAC-13).
